sloka: शीघ्रं गच्छत्वयं वीरो दण्डकान्परिरक्षितुम् ।दूषणो ऽस्य बलाध्यक्षो भविष्यति महाबलः ।। ७.२४.३८ ॥
transliteration: śīghraṁ gacchatvayaṁ vīro daṇḍakānparirakṣitum ।dūṣaṇo 'sya balādhyakṣo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ।। 7.24.38 ॥

translations.english: Let this hero quickly go to protect the Dandaka forest, and the very powerful Dushana will be his commander of forces.
